about.title: Rohnert Park Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a crash on Rohnert Park Expressway, Redwood Drive, or Golf Course Drive takes a loved one's life, the grief is compounded by confusion about what comes next. Sonoma County recorded traffic deaths alongside dozens of injury collisions in the most recent reporting year, a reminder that families here regularly face this kind of sudden loss. California law gives certain surviving family members, starting with spouses, domestic partners, and children, the right to pursue a wrongful death claim against the party responsible. Our team evaluates the circumstances of the death, explains what compensation may be available, and handles the legal work while your family focuses on healing. There's no cost to you unless we recover money on your behalf.

whyChoose.title: Why Rohnert Park Families Choose Us

items.title: Standing Rules Can Be Confusing
items.desc: California limits who can file a wrongful death claim, generally starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children before other dependents or heirs. We can clarify where your family fits and who should bring the claim.

items.title: The Clock Starts Immediately
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims in California must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity is involved, such as a claim tied to a public road. Contacting us early helps preserve evidence and protect your family's deadline.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Funeral Costs
items.desc: A wrongful death action can address funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. These are separate from any criminal case that may result from the same incident.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: California law generally gives priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children. If none of those exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing depending on the circumstances. We can review your family's situation and confirm who is eligible to bring the claim.

items.question: Rohnert Park Expressway and Redwood Drive see a lot of traffic. Does that affect our case?
items.answer: Crash patterns on high-volume corridors like these can matter because they may point to specific factors, such as timing, right-of-way, or driver behavior, that we will investigate. Public collision records for these roads can help establish the circumstances of the crash, but every case still depends on its own facts.

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim after a fatal crash?
items.answer: In most cases, California gives families two years from the date of death to file a civil wrongful death claim. If a government entity or public roadway is involved, the deadline to file an initial claim can be much shorter, sometimes just months. Because of this, it's important to speak with us as soon as your family is able.
